```{r seuil utilisés}
## nombre de jours en dessous duquel on considère qu'on est en début de lactation
## en moyenne avant première IA
early_dim_cutoff <- 90
## SCC cut-off
## seuil de cellules au-delà duquel on considère
## qu'il y a mammite clinique
scc_high_cutoff <- 200
```

# Chargement des données utiles

```{r}
lac <- read.csv2("generated_datasets/lac_final.csv")
```

# Probabilité d'un SCC élevé au dernier contrôle avant tarissement

## modélisation 

```{r}
lac <- lac |> 
  mutate(parKat = relevel(as.factor(ifelse(parity > 3, 4, parity)), ref = "3"))
```


```{r}
scc_high_dp_model <- glmer(infct_end_lac ~ parKat +
                             milk_early_max_scaled_p1 +
                             milk_early_max_scaled_p2 +
                             milk_early_max_scaled_p3 +
                             milk_early_max_scaled_p4 +
                             mast_cat1 +
                             (1| herd_id),
                           family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                           data = lac, 
                           subset = n_ctrl_early > 0 & repro == 1 & dp_mis == 0 & !is.na(infct_end_lac))

summary(scc_high_dp_model)
```

## Prédictions 

```{r}
prd <- predictions(model = scc_high_dp_model,
                   newdata = mast_pred,
                   re.form = NA, type = "response")

ggplot(prd, aes(x = factor(mast_cat1, level = level_order), y = estimate)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_segment(aes(x = mast_cat1, y=conf.low, xend = mast_cat1, yend = conf.high))+
  xlab("")+
  ylab("probabilité d'un SCC élevé au dernier contrôle avant tarissement")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))
```

# Probabilité de guérison au tarissement 

## modélisation 

```{r}
cure_dp_model <- glmer(nxt_cure ~ parKat +
                          milk_early_max_scaled_p1 +
                             milk_early_max_scaled_p2 +
                             milk_early_max_scaled_p3 +
                             milk_early_max_scaled_p4 +
                             mast_cat1 +
                             (1| herd_id),
                           family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                           data = lac, 
                           subset = n_ctrl_early > 0 & repro == 1 & dp_mis == 0 & !is.na(nxt_cure))

summary(cure_dp_model)
```

## Prédictions

```{r}
prd1 <- predictions(model = cure_dp_model,
                   newdata = mast_pred,
                   re.form = NA, type = "response")

ggplot(prd1, aes(x = factor(mast_cat1, level = level_order), y = estimate)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_segment(aes(x = mast_cat1, y=conf.low, xend = mast_cat1, yend = conf.high))+
  xlab("")+

  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))
```
# Probabilité d'une nouvelle infection après tarissement

## modélisation 

```{r}

                          milk_early_max_scaled_p1 +
                             milk_early_max_scaled_p2 +
                             milk_early_max_scaled_p3 +
                             milk_early_max_scaled_p4 +
                             mast_cat1 +

                           family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                           data = lac, 
                           subset = n_ctrl_early > 0 & repro == 1 & dp_mis == 0 & !is.na(nxt_ninf))

summary(new_inf_model)
```

## Prédictions 

